rule: Separate worktrees and branches are mandatory. Ownership is by semantic authority, not merely filename. Shared-file edits require a committed handoff before the second worker edits or merges.
coordination_required_paths: any file already modified by the other active worker branch
pre_edit_check: git status --short must show only own expected changes
compare intended touched paths against other worker's last handoff/commit
if same shared path is required, STOP and exchange WORKER-HANDOFF-CONTRACT before editing
merge_rule: Do not resolve a semantic conflict by choosing whichever side compiles. The owning worker resolves its semantic authority; the consuming worker then rebases/consumes the committed contract.
forbidden: silent edit of other worker's semantic lane
large opportunistic refactor of a coordination-required file
